messages:
anne: Quick heads-up — 30m all-hands next Wed 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda:
- Q3 priorities: product roadmap + Dedicated capacity scaling
- Mini demo: runtime tail-latency improvements
- Policy note: short update on data retention & audit logs
- Open Q&A
Please drop questions here or add to the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/allhands/q3-prep :raised_hands:

maria: Adding a question — what's the tentative timeline for Dedicated early access? Can we get a slide on migration considerations?

sam: Will this be recorded? I’m heads-down in meetings at 10am PT and don’t want to miss it. :eyes:

ryan: I can run the mini demo — will show the tail-latency fix and a quick before/after.
ryan: Demo command I'll use (so folks can try afterwards):
```bash
redwoodctl bench --model redwood-v1 --concurrency 8 --requests 250
```

devops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://videos.redwood.ai/allhands/3501234567-recording.mp4 — transcript available at the same link.

elaine: Quick post-meeting TL;DR from the notes:
- Recording + slides: https://videos.redwood.ai/allhands/3501234567-recording.mp4 + https://docs.redwood.ai/allhands/q3-slides.pdf
- Dedicated early access: tentative July 15 launch window; pre-launch checklist being finalized, expect confirmation by next Tuesday
- Runtime demo: canary shows ~15% median latency reduction and ~25% fewer tail spikes; PR #412 contains perf graphs and config knobs
- Data retention policy update: default logs retention set to 90 days; orgs with enterprise plans can opt into 365-day retention via support ticket.
Thanks all — keep questions here or email allhands@redwood.ai :sparkles:
